expected.controller_behavior: repeated reevaluation should convert login-path pressure into progressive scale-up on the service path actually identified by the controller
expected.final_replica_behavior: replicas should climb progressively and end in a stable higher state
expected.pattern_behavior: login-path pressure should start already high, step up again, and remain sustained long enough for repeated reevaluation
expected.pass_fail_criteria: pass if the controller scales up progressively, reaches a stable higher replica count, and materially reduces sustained pressure
expected.replica_trend: increase in steps and then stabilize
expected.slo_behavior: some early breach is acceptable, but the controller should respond quickly enough to improve the path over time
expected.slo_protection_result: front-end SLO should show improved protection after scaling starts
expected.traffic_pattern: start at 250 RPS on login, step up to 450 RPS, then stay at 450 RPS
